title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck semigroup maximal operator on weighted $L^p$ space
summary: Let $(\mathcal{H}\_t)_{t \geq 0}$ denote the standard Ornstein-Uhlenbeck semigroup over ambient space $\mathbb R^d$ equipped with Gaussian measure $dγ(x) = e^{-|x|^2} dx$. Further let $\mathcal{H}^*(f)(x) = \sup_{t > 0} \mathcal{H}_t(|f|)(x)$ denote the associated maximal operator.
